sumo.tips: Good Sumo players keep to the middle, fight facing out of danger, and use W-taps to push without being pushed back.
sumo.record: Record 20 minutes of yourself playing Sumo (F7), and mark your best pushes as good.

spleef.tips: Good Spleef players keep moving, break blocks under the opponent's path, and never stand next to a hole.
spleef.record: Record a few Spleef rounds and mark the moments you trapped someone.

tnt_run.tips: Keep running on fresh blocks, never backtrack over your own trail, and drop a layer only when you must.

dropper.tips: Only new depth counts, and only if it lands safely: water, slime or a careful route.
dropper.record: Record yourself finishing a few drops.

bridging.tips: Sneak at the edge, look down and back, place on the block's side, keep a steady rhythm.
bridging.record: Record 10 minutes of you bridging; mark falls as mistakes.

crystal.tips: Place obsidian, then crystal, then hit it while the enemy is near it and you aren't; totems and gapples keep you alive.
crystal.record: Record crystal fights; losses are learned from automatically.

sword.tips: Crits from falls, W-taps after each hit, keep the spacing, block or strafe when they swing.
sword.record: Record your duels and mark good exchanges.

bow.tips: Draw fully, lead moving targets, and don't spend arrows on hopeless shots.

survival.tips: Eat before it's urgent, shelter at night, keep a weapon and food on the hotbar.

mining.tips: Strip-mine at the right height, light the way, and never dig straight down.

wastes_items.why: A cost for items used for nothing (missed arrows, pointless pearls, unused healing, eating while full); a few per round stay free.

hurts_itself.why: A penalty for damage it does to itself (its own crystals or TNT, falls, lava).

falls_off.why: Penalties for falling into the void and for hanging around edges.

too_passive.why: More reward for dealing damage and closing in.

takes_too_much.why: A penalty for damage taken and a reward for keeping a good distance.

swings_early.why: A small penalty for swinging before the attack has recharged.

not_improving.why: Re-check its rewards against your marked clips, then try different practice.
